slot_note: seed DQ09 (whether a step in the case series is flagged as a series break caused by testing volume): the decision (which series carry a break flag in the next publication) and the quantity (the step a change in testing put into a case series, set against the infections behind it) kept; the world moves from the seed's laboratory network to a state's notified influenza and its sentinel general practice network, and the seed's positivity method is not the answer here (it is the analyst's trap, and task234 spent positivity as an estimator)
niche: a state communicable diseases branch's weekly influenza report deciding which health regions' notified influenza series carry a testing-change break flag, judged on how far each region's testing change moved the share of its influenza infections that get notified, read against the sentinel general practices' influenza-like-illness consultations and the share of their protocol swabs positive for influenza, in a winter when point-of-care testing reached some regions' general practices, others moved emergency departments to multiplex panels, one closed its drive-through clinics and RSV peaked in the north
answer: Flag the notified influenza series of Far North, Metropolitan South, Metropolitan West and South Coast from the report weeks of their testing changes in the week 36 report, and not those of North Coast, Tablelands, Central West and Metropolitan North.
stakeholder_role: surveillance epidemiologist in a state communicable diseases branch who signs off the weekly influenza report's data quality flags

spine.entity: one influenza result a laboratory or a point-of-care service reported to the notification gateway, positive or negative, preliminary or final

world.geography: Australia (a state health department; generic region names; personas on the en_AU index)
world.org_type: state health department, communicable diseases branch

driver: A change in how a source captures cases changes which cases it reaches as well as how many, so the capture rate read against the source's own attempts moves with the change itself; the share captured is read instead against an independent fixed-protocol sample's volume times the share of that sample carrying the condition, which no change in capture reaches, while the raw count confounds the change with the season's rise and a ratio to the sample's unattributed volume confounds it with other causes of the same signal.
driver_concrete: A region's testing change (point-of-care tests in general practice, multiplex panels in emergency departments, a drive-through clinic closing) moves who gets an influenza test as well as how many, so each region's positivity moves with the change itself; the sentinel practices swab a fixed protocol sample of their influenza-like-illness patients that no regional testing change reaches, so their consultations times their swab positivity track the region's influenza infections, and notifications against that index give the change in the share notified, while raw notifications confound the change with the season's rise and notifications per influenza-like-illness consultation confound it with RSV, which fills the same consultations.
stump: A competent solver adjusts for testing by comparing each region's positivity in the four weeks from its testing change with the four weeks before and files 5 of the 8 regions wrong (North Coast, Tablelands, Central West and Metropolitan North flagged, Far North missed); the step that lands it there is reading the share of infections notified off the tests the region's own services ran, which the testing change itself moved, instead of off the sentinel practices' influenza-like-illness consultations attributed to influenza by their protocol swabs, which no testing change reaches.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who builds the cases from the gateway's results under the protocol (episodes, regions by residential postcode, weeks by collection date, panel rows and preliminary reports one specimen) and reads every clause, then judges each region's testing change on the change in its positivity over the four weeks either side, files 5 of the 8 regions wrong (North Coast, Tablelands, Central West and Metropolitan North flagged, Far North missed); raw notifications and the unchanged regions as controls file 5 wrong each, and notifications per influenza-like-illness consultation or per swab positivity flag all eight.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the change in a region's influenza ascertainment, the share of its infections that are notified, estimated against the sentinel general practice network's influenza-like-illness consultations attributed to influenza by its protocol swabs, the surveillance field's own syndromic and virological index; with tills, meters or wards for regions there is no syndrome that several viruses fill, no protocol swab that attributes it, and no testing change that moves who gets tested, and the task stops making sense.

differentiation.task234: task234 predicts each laboratory stream's tests from its own positivity, a share no lost message moves; this build judges a change in who gets tested, which moves positivity itself, so positivity is the trap and the share notified is read against an independent sentinel index built from syndromic consultations and protocol swabs
differentiation.task453: task453 reads a measurement change's size from the rotation months in which only a panel's newest units got the new measurement, its effect varying by occasion; this build has no panel or rotation: it reads the change in the share of a region's infections that its notifications catch against an independent sentinel index (syndromic consultations times protocol-swab positivity) that no testing change reaches, the region's own positivity being moved by the change
differentiation.task463: task463 measures a spending-weighted price index's change through comparisons that avoid the cut periods' weights; this build weights and links nothing: it sets a region's notifications against the sentinel network's influenza-attributed consultations on either side of the region's testing change
differentiation.task480: task480 (v1) reads old meters' under-registration against units of the same kind whose meter did not change over the same periods; this build has no comparison group (the unchanged regions are a wrong rung here): it reads a region's notifications against an independent sentinel index, syndromic consultations times protocol-swab positivity, that no testing change reaches
differentiation.task464: task464 (v8) recovers a population's division between categories by inverting per-category hit rates measured on a re-classified sample; this build has no classifier and no validation sample: it sets each region's notifications against the sentinel network's influenza-attributed consultations either side of a change in who gets tested

notes: Decisive G16 (which infection proxy the shipped data supports: the sentinel consultations attributed to influenza by the protocol swabs), G6 supporting (a testing change moves the population tested, so the region's own positivity moves with it, the default path's trap), G14 (the influenza-like-illness rate pools influenza with RSV and other viruses). The data quality protocol files the WHAT (a region's notified series carries a testing-change break flag when the change moved the share of the region's influenza infections notified by more than a quarter, four weeks after against four weeks before) and no method; the sentinel protocol describes the network as sentinel protocols do. Seed DQ09's world (a laboratory network adding a laboratory) and its positivity method are not used.
